## Computing 13 × 7

**Breaking it apart** (splitting 13 into 10 + 3):

$$13 \times 7 = (10 + 3) \times 7$$

Distribute the 7:

$$= (10 \times 7) + (3 \times 7)$$

$$= 70 + 21$$

$$= \boxed{91}$$

**Verification** (adding 13 seven times):
$$13 + 13 + 13 + 13 + 13 + 13 + 13 = 91$$

So **13 × 7 = 91**.
